WHO WE ARE

Engineering Reliable Rubber Solutions for Industry

Formula Rub Tech is an established industrial rubber manufacturing enterprise headquartered in Vasai East, Maharashtra. Founded by Mr. Abhin Dhananjay, who brings extensive directorship expertise in the rubber sector, our facility is engineered to deliver high-durability rubber components at competitive pricing.

We specialize in the end-to-end production of precision rubber extrusions and compression-moulded components. Formulated from premium synthetic and natural polymers—including Silicone, Nitrile (NBR), Neoprene, Viton (FKM), EPDM, SBR, and Butyl—every component is designed in accordance with strict ISO quality guidelines to endure demanding industrial operating environments.

POLYMER SCIENCE & COMPOUNDING

The Right Rubber Material for Every Application

Our material engineering covers a spectrum of 8 specialized elastomers. We compound and vulcanize each formulation to achieve precise Shore A hardness, elongation, chemical resilience, and thermal endurance.

NR

Natural Rubber

NR (Polyisoprene)

High elasticity elastomer harvested from latex with unmatched tensile strength, mechanical resilience, and tear resistance.

Superior tensile strength & elongation
Excellent dynamic rebound elasticity
High resistance to tear & fatigue
Ideal Applications:

Anti-vibration mounts, heavy duty buffer pads, mechanical bushings

VMQ

Silicone Rubber

VMQ (Silicone)

Inorganic synthetic polymer retaining flexibility and chemical stability across extreme thermal bands without degradation.

Broad thermal range stability
Excellent dielectric & electrical insulation
High ozone & ultraviolet inertness
Ideal Applications:

Thermal seals, electrical enclosures, medical & food processing components

NBR

Nitrile Rubber

NBR (Buna-N)

The premier workhorse synthetic rubber for applications requiring immersion in petroleum-based oils, fuels, and hydraulic fluids.

Outstanding petroleum & fuel resistance
Low compression set under pressure
Robust mechanical abrasion endurance
Ideal Applications:

Hydraulic O-rings, U-seals, oil seals, automotive fuel gaskets

CR

Neoprene Rubber

CR (Chloroprene)

A versatile multi-purpose elastomer balancing chemical inertness, flame retardancy, weather endurance, and mechanical toughness.

Moderate oil & petroleum resistance
Excellent resistance to ozone & weathering
Inherent flame self-extinguishing behavior
Ideal Applications:

Industrial expansion joints, outdoor weather seals, marine bumpers

FKM

Viton / FKM

FKM (Fluoroelastomer)

High-performance fluorinated elastomer providing exceptional resistance to aggressive chemicals, acids, and elevated temperatures.

Superior chemical & solvent inertness
High temperature structural integrity
Extreme oxidation & ozone resistance
Ideal Applications:

Chemical processing valves, high-spec aerospace seals, severe duty O-rings

EPDM

EPDM Rubber

EPDM (Ethylene Propylene)

Terpolymer elastomer offering unmatched resistance to direct sunlight exposure, atmospheric ozone, steam, and polar fluids.

Exceptional UV, ozone & weather durability
High resistance to steam & hot water
Good resistance to mild acids & alkalis
Ideal Applications:

Continuous extruded profiles, outdoor weather-stripping, cooling hoses

SBR

SBR Rubber

SBR (Styrene-Butadiene)

Cost-effective general purpose synthetic rubber delivering high abrasion endurance and mechanical cushioning under load.

Excellent abrasion & friction wear resistance
Favorable compression set recovery
Economical for high-volume manufacturing
Ideal Applications:

Heavy duty machinery pads, industrial conveyor skirting, structural buffers

IIR

Butyl Rubber

IIR (Isobutylene Isoprene)

Specialized synthetic copolymer characterized by exceptionally low gas permeation, dampening capacity, and moisture resistance.

Lowest gas & vapor permeability rate
High mechanical vibration damping
Excellent chemical resistance to mineral acids
Ideal Applications:

Pressure diaphragms, pneumatic bladders, vacuum sealing gaskets

Unsure which elastomer matches your chemical or thermal parameters?

Our engineering team evaluates oil exposure, ozone contact, pressure cycles, and durometer needs.

Manufacturing Capabilities That Deliver Precision

SECTORS SERVED

Industries & Engineering Applications

From precision O-rings in hydraulic systems to heavy-duty anti-vibrators in industrial plant machinery, Formula Rub Tech rubber components fulfill critical functional roles across industrial sectors.

Sealing

Fluid containment & pressure isolation across static and dynamic joints.

Insulation

High dielectric resistance for high-voltage and control equipment.

Vibration Reduction

Attenuation of cyclic mechanical harmonics and acoustic noise.

Protection

Dust, moisture, oil, and atmospheric ozone exclusion.

Cushioning

High-modulus deadweight support and concentrated impact absorption.

Sealing & Vibration Damping

Automotive & Transportation

Ensuring fluid containment and chassis vibration isolation under harsh dynamic cycles.

Automotive systems rely on rubber components to seal fluids, prevent environmental contamination, and decouple road harmonics from passenger cabins and delicate sensor units.

Key Components Supplied:
Engine GasketsSteering BellowsO-Rings & Fuel SealsSuspension BushesDoor Weatherstrips
High-Pressure Sealing

Industrial Machinery & Hydraulics

Withstanding severe hydraulic pressure spikes and continuous reciprocating wear.

From heavy hydraulic presses to industrial pumps, elastomeric U-seals and precision O-rings maintain hydraulic integrity, prevent fluid bypass, and extend machinery rebuild intervals.

Key Components Supplied:
Hydraulic U-SealsPiston WipersHigh-Pressure O-RingsFlange GasketsFlexible Couplings
Vibration Reduction & Cushioning

Heavy Engineering & Plants

Isolating rotating equipment resonance and mitigating impact stress.

Heavy manufacturing plants use anti-vibration mounts and heavy-duty rubber pads to isolate rotating machinery, preventing destructive structural fatigue and dampening operational noise.

Key Components Supplied:
Anti-Vibrator MountsHeavy Machine PadsExpansion JointsBuffer StopsMolded Bumpers
Dielectric Insulation & Ingress Protection

Electrical & Enclosures

Preventing moisture ingress and providing high dielectric resistance.

Extruded silicone and EPDM profiles form watertight IP-rated seals around electrical cabinets, control panels, and outdoor switchgear, protecting critical electronics from dust and water.

Key Components Supplied:
Cabinet GasketsInsulation GrommetsSilicone Enclosure SealsCable SleevesTerminal Caps
Weatherproofing & Joint Protection

Construction & Infrastructure

Accommodating thermal structural movement and excluding wind-driven rain.

Elastomeric profiles and heavy sheets bridge architectural expansion joints, provide curtain wall glazing seals, and prevent water ingress across buildings and civil works.

Key Components Supplied:
Glazing ProfilesExpansion Joint SealsNeoprene Bearing PadsChannel GasketsWaterstop Profiles
Material Flow & Fluid Protection

General Manufacturing & Processing

Providing chemical-resistant barriers and dependable fluid transmission.

Chemical processing plants, food lines, and automated packaging systems deploy Viton, Nitrile, and Silicone components to safely handle aggressive media and maintain hygienic boundaries.

Key Components Supplied:
Pump DiaphragmsProcess Valve O-RingsConveyor Rubber SkirtingSanitary GasketsCustom Molded Parts

QUALITY PROTOCOLS

Quality Is Built Into Every Stage

Reliability in high-pressure fluid sealing and critical vibration damping demands uncompromising quality controls. We design and inspect all components in accordance with ISO manufacturing benchmarks.

01

Raw Material Inspection

Polymer Purity & Chemical Testing

Every incoming batch of raw synthetic and natural rubber, carbon black, and curing agents is tested for specific gravity, moisture, and chemical purity before mixing.

Verification Stage 1
02

Manufacturing Process Checks

Thermal, Curing & Pressure Monitoring

Hydraulic platen temperatures, curing cycle dwell times, and extrusion screw feed rates are tightly monitored to ensure uniform cross-linking across every piece.

Verification Stage 2
03

Product Quality Inspection

Micrometer, Caliper & Shore A Hardness

Moulded and extruded pieces are measured with precision micrometers and calipers against engineering tolerances, accompanied by Shore A durometer hardness verification.

Verification Stage 3
04

Final Product Verification

Zero-Defect Batch Clearance & Dispatch

100% visual screening for flash defects, air inclusions, or surface blemishes ensures only components meeting customer specifications are packaged and dispatched.

Verification Stage 4
ISO Quality Framework Guidelines

Stringent Dimensional & Shore A Hardness Tolerances

Every customer drawing has critical sealing and mounting tolerances. Whether producing Shore 40 A soft silicone bellows or Shore 90 A rigid hydraulic U-seals, our multi-stage inspection eliminates dimensional deviation and assures consistent performance.
